newsitem.title: FRANCE: Royal Brunei Air to appoint France cargo agent.
newsitem.headline: Royal Brunei Air to appoint France cargo agent.

text.p: Royal Brunei Airlines said it is hoping to appoint an off-line cargo sales agent in France later this year.

"We had planned to start scheduled Boeing 767-300 passenger services between Paris and Brunei in autumn 1997 but network development has been put on hold following the arrival of a new managing director," an RBA official told Reuters.
"We are now looking at a launch date some time in 1998," he said.

The official added: "All being well, we will appoint France sales agents for both off-line cargo and passenger traffic in the next three months and this will prepare the ground for when we go on-line from Paris," the official said.
Royal Brunei operates scheduled 767-300 passenger service from London and Frankfurt to Brunei.
